title: A kitchen story, ready for real project details.
paragraphs: This illustrative kitchen writeup shows how a project story could explain design choices before construction. It is a Draft example, paired with a stock photo, and does not describe work completed by Miller Remodeling.

A useful kitchen plan starts with how the room is used: room to prepare meals, clear paths between appliances, and storage within reach. A future Miller project story will use approved photos and describe the actual scope and decisions.

image.alt: Stock example: light kitchen cabinets surrounding a glass dining table beneath a chandelier.
